subject.title: fix(agents): hard-deadline runtime auth refresh to prevent gateway deadlock

question: Should this auth-deadline PR land with the current abandon-and-guard design after final rebase/CI, or should owners require a different cancellation/ownership model before merge?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and fixes a real availability bug, but it changes provider credential refresh timing and stale credential side-effect handling in a security-sensitive auth path.

options.title: Land after auth/security owner review
options.body: Accept the guarded hard-deadline design, verify the exact merged head preserves SecretRef egress protection, and land once required checks are green.

options.title: Require a different cancellation model
options.body: Ask for a design that avoids abandoning uncancellable auth work or moves the ownership checks deeper into the persisted write helpers before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader auth incident design
options.body: Defer this focused availability mitigation until the broader auth/profile quarantine and operator-status work is ready, accepting that the deadlock class remains on main longer.
